h1: Use Hanzo AI with GitHub Copilot

p: Extend your GitHub Copilot workflow with Hanzo AI for access to additional models and capabilities via the API. Use Hanzo for tasks Copilot can't handle.
API Key: Get yours at platform.hanzo.ai/api-keys · Fully OpenAI-compatible · every model on the gateway available
License: Proprietary · View source on GitHub →
Hanzo AI is OpenAI-compatible, so existing GitHub Copilot code works with zero refactoring. We deeply appreciate the GitHub / Microsoft team for building and maintaining this open-source project.

code: # Use GitHub Copilot in editor, Hanzo API in code from openai import OpenAI # Hanzo for programmatic access client = OpenAI ( base_url= " https://api.hanzo.ai/v1 " , api_key= " your-hanzo-api-key " , ) # Access the models Copilot does not carry response = client . chat . completions . create ( model= " zen4-pro " , messages= [{ " role " : " user " , " content " : " Review this code... " }], )

// In CI: use Hanzo AI for code review import OpenAI from " openai " ; const client = new OpenAI ({ baseURL : " https://api.hanzo.ai/v1 " , apiKey : process.env.HANZO_API_KEY , }); const review = await client.chat.completions. create ({ model : " zen4-pro " , messages : [{ role : " user " , content : ` Review this PR diff: ${ diff }` , }], });

name : AI Code Review on : [ pull_request ] jobs : review : runs-on : ubuntu-latest steps : - uses : actions/checkout@v4 - name : AI Review env : HANZO_API_KEY : ${{ secrets.HANZO_API_KEY }} run : | pip install openai python scripts/ai_review.py
# Add to GitHub repo secrets # Settings > Secrets > Actions > New secret # Name: HANZO_API_KEY # Value: your-hanzo-api-key

p: Create a free account and get your API key. The Free plan includes free model requests and Kai decisions, no card.
